name: Possession share
descriptionQuick: How much of the ball a team had, measured by passes.
descriptionExplore: Share of all attempted passes in the match that this team made, split by half and score state.
descriptionAdvanced: Pass-based possession: team passes attempted / (both teams' passes attempted) x 100. Not time-based.

providerCaveats.statsbomb: Pass-based, so values differ slightly from time-in-possession figures shown by broadcasters.

name: Possessions
descriptionQuick: How many separate spells on the ball the team had.
descriptionExplore: Count of possession chains (consecutive events with the same StatsBomb possession number) won by the team.
descriptionAdvanced: Chain = events sharing (period, possession); owner = possession_team.

providerCaveats.statsbomb: StatsBomb Open Data events; coordinates converted from 120x80 to metres on 105x68.

name: Passes per possession
descriptionQuick: How patient the team was: passes in a typical possession.
descriptionExplore: Mean number of passes per possession chain; higher values suggest patient build-up, low values a direct style.
descriptionAdvanced: mean over team chains of count(pass events by team in chain).
formula: sum(passes in team chains) / count(team chains)

providerCaveats.statsbomb: StatsBomb Open Data events; coordinates converted from 120x80 to metres on 105x68.

name: Final-third entries
descriptionQuick: How often the team got the ball into the attacking third.
descriptionExplore: Possessions in which the team had an on-ball action or completed a pass/carry ending beyond 70 m.
descriptionAdvanced: Count of team chains with any event location x >= 70 m or completed pass/carry end_x >= 70 m (canonical 105 m pitch).

providerCaveats.statsbomb: StatsBomb Open Data events; coordinates converted from 120x80 to metres on 105x68.

name: Box entries
descriptionQuick: How often the team got the ball into the penalty area.
descriptionExplore: Possessions that reached the opponent's penalty area through a completed pass, carry or touch.
descriptionAdvanced: Penalty area: x >= 88.5 m and 13.84 <= y <= 54.16 m. Count of team chains with any event or completed pass/carry end in that area.

providerCaveats.statsbomb: StatsBomb Open Data events; coordinates converted from 120x80 to metres on 105x68.

name: Expected threat added (xT)
descriptionQuick: How much the team's passes and carries moved the ball into dangerous places.
descriptionExplore: Sum of the change in expected threat for every completed pass and carry. Positive values mean the ball moved somewhere more likely to lead to a goal.
descriptionAdvanced: Static 12x8 xT grid (Karun Singh, open v1). For each completed pass/carry: xT(end cell) - xT(start cell); summed per team/player. The grid was fitted on another dataset.
formula: sum(xT(end) - xT(start)) over completed passes and carries

providerCaveats.statsbomb: Grid not fitted on StatsBomb Open Data; treat as an estimate.

name: xT by lane
descriptionQuick: Which side of the pitch the team created threat from.
descriptionExplore: Positive xT added, split across five vertical lanes (left wing, left half-space, centre, right half-space, right wing).
descriptionAdvanced: Positive xT of completed passes/carries grouped by the lane of the action's end location; returned as share of total positive xT.

providerCaveats.statsbomb: StatsBomb Open Data events; coordinates converted from 120x80 to metres on 105x68.

name: Passes attempted
descriptionQuick: How many passes the team tried.
descriptionExplore: All pass events, including set-piece deliveries.
descriptionAdvanced: count(type=pass)

providerCaveats.statsbomb: StatsBomb Open Data events; coordinates converted from 120x80 to metres on 105x68.

name: Pass completion
descriptionQuick: How many passes reached a teammate.
descriptionExplore: Completed passes divided by attempted passes.
descriptionAdvanced: StatsBomb completed = pass.outcome absent. Excludes passes with outcome Unknown from the denominator.

providerCaveats.statsbomb: StatsBomb Open Data events; coordinates converted from 120x80 to metres on 105x68.

name: Passing network
descriptionQuick: Who passed to whom, and where players usually received the ball.
descriptionExplore: Average positions of players on the ball and the number of completed passes between each pair.
descriptionAdvanced: Nodes: players with >= 1 pass or receipt; position = mean of pass start (as passer) and pass end (as recipient). Edges: completed passes passer -> recipient. Computed for the full match and up to the team's first substitution.

providerCaveats.statsbomb: StatsBomb Open Data events; coordinates converted from 120x80 to metres on 105x68.

name: Progressive passes
descriptionQuick: Passes that moved the ball significantly towards goal.
descriptionExplore: Completed open-play passes that brought the ball much closer to the opponent goal.
descriptionAdvanced: Tactiq v1 (Wyscout-style thresholds): completed open-play pass whose distance to goal centre (105,34) decreases by >= 30 m when start and end are in own half, >= 15 m when crossing halves, >= 10 m when both in opponent half. Set pieces (corner, free kick, throw-in, goal kick, kick-off) excluded.

providerCaveats.statsbomb: Thresholds are Tactiq v1; FBref/Opta use different rules, so values are not directly comparable.

name: Progressive carries
descriptionQuick: Runs with the ball that moved it significantly towards goal.
descriptionExplore: Carries that met the same distance rule as progressive passes.
descriptionAdvanced: Same thresholds as progressive passes applied to carry start/end.

providerCaveats.statsbomb: StatsBomb Open Data events; coordinates converted from 120x80 to metres on 105x68.

name: Progressive distance
descriptionQuick: Total distance the team moved the ball towards goal with passes and carries.
descriptionExplore: Sum of forward distance gained by completed passes and carries (only gains counted).
descriptionAdvanced: sum(max(0, d_goal(start) - d_goal(end))) for completed passes and carries.

providerCaveats.statsbomb: StatsBomb Open Data events; coordinates converted from 120x80 to metres on 105x68.

name: Progression lanes
descriptionQuick: Which channels the team used to move forward.
descriptionExplore: Share of progressive passes and carries ending in each of the five vertical lanes.
descriptionAdvanced: Lane boundaries every 13.6 m across the 68 m width.

providerCaveats.statsbomb: StatsBomb Open Data events; coordinates converted from 120x80 to metres on 105x68.

name: Zone 14 receptions
descriptionQuick: How often the team found a player in the dangerous area just outside the box.
descriptionExplore: Completed passes received in zone 14, the central area in front of the penalty box.
descriptionAdvanced: Zone 14 (Tactiq v1) = x in [70, 87.5) m, y in [22.67, 45.33) m. Count of completed passes ending there.

providerCaveats.statsbomb: StatsBomb Open Data events; coordinates converted from 120x80 to metres on 105x68.

name: Build-up success
descriptionQuick: How often the team played out from the back into the attacking third.
descriptionExplore: Share of possessions starting in the team's own third (open play, goal kick or keeper) that reached the final third.
descriptionAdvanced: Denominator: team chains starting at x < 35 m with play pattern Regular Play, From Goal Kick or From Keeper. Numerator: those that reached x >= 70 m.

providerCaveats.statsbomb: StatsBomb Open Data events; coordinates converted from 120x80 to metres on 105x68.

name: PPDA
descriptionQuick: How many passes the opponent was allowed before the team tried to win the ball. Lower usually means more aggressive pressing.
descriptionExplore: Opponent passes in their own 60% of the pitch divided by the team's tackles, interceptions and fouls in that same area.
descriptionAdvanced: Tactiq v1: opponent open-play passes attempted with start x <= 63 m (their own 60%) / team defensive actions at x >= 42 m (mirror zone), where defensive actions = Duel(type Tackle, any outcome) + Interception + Foul Committed. Pressure events excluded; see pressing.ppda_incl_pressures.

providerCaveats.statsbomb: Action set differs from some public sources (e.g. inclusion of challenges/pressures), so values will not match FBref or Opta exactly.

name: PPDA incl. pressures
descriptionQuick: A pressing measure that also counts closing-down actions.
descriptionExplore: Like PPDA but every StatsBomb Pressure event in the zone also counts as a defensive action.
descriptionAdvanced: As pressing.ppda with Pressure added to the denominator.

providerCaveats.statsbomb: StatsBomb-specific: other providers do not record pressures.

name: Pressures
descriptionQuick: How often players closed down an opponent on the ball.
descriptionExplore: Count of StatsBomb pressure events.
descriptionAdvanced: count(type=pressure)

providerCaveats.statsbomb: StatsBomb-specific event; not available from most event providers.

name: Pressure regains (5s)
descriptionQuick: Pressures that won the ball back within five seconds.
descriptionExplore: Pressure events followed by the pressing team gaining possession within 5 seconds.
descriptionAdvanced: Pressure at t; a new chain owned by the pressing team starts within (t, t+5s] in the same period.

providerCaveats.statsbomb: StatsBomb Open Data events; coordinates converted from 120x80 to metres on 105x68.

name: High turnovers
descriptionQuick: How often the team won the ball close to the opponent's goal.
descriptionExplore: Open-play possessions that the team started within 40 m of the opponent goal.
descriptionAdvanced: Team chain whose play pattern is Regular Play or From Counter and whose first located event is <= 40 m from goal centre (105,34).

providerCaveats.statsbomb: StatsBomb Open Data events; coordinates converted from 120x80 to metres on 105x68.

name: Shots after high turnovers
descriptionQuick: How often winning the ball high led to a shot.
descriptionExplore: High-turnover possessions that ended with a shot.
descriptionAdvanced: High turnover chains containing a shot by the team.

providerCaveats.statsbomb: StatsBomb Open Data events; coordinates converted from 120x80 to metres on 105x68.

name: Defensive action height
descriptionQuick: How far up the pitch the team usually tried to win the ball.
descriptionExplore: Average distance from the team's own goal line of its tackles, interceptions, fouls, ball recoveries and pressures.
descriptionAdvanced: Mean x (metres from own goal line) of Duel(Tackle), Interception, Foul Committed, Ball Recovery and Pressure events. An event-based proxy for block height, not a tracking measure.

providerCaveats.statsbomb: Event-based proxy. True defensive line height needs tracking data.

name: Counterpress regains
descriptionQuick: Times the team won the ball back quickly after losing it.
descriptionExplore: Possessions regained within 5 seconds of losing the ball.
descriptionAdvanced: For each team turnover (team chain followed by opponent chain), the team starts a new chain within 5 s of the opponent chain start (same period). Also reported for 3 s and 8 s windows in value_json.

providerCaveats.statsbomb: StatsBomb Open Data events; coordinates converted from 120x80 to metres on 105x68.

name: Counterpress regain rate
descriptionQuick: How often losing the ball was immediately followed by winning it back.
descriptionExplore: Share of possessions lost in open play that the team won back within 5 seconds.
descriptionAdvanced: counterpress_regains(5s) / open-play turnovers. value_json holds 3/5/8 s windows.

providerCaveats.statsbomb: StatsBomb Open Data events; coordinates converted from 120x80 to metres on 105x68.

name: Counter-attack shots
descriptionQuick: Shots that came from counter-attacks.
descriptionExplore: Shots in possessions StatsBomb labels as From Counter.
descriptionAdvanced: Shots in chains with play_pattern = From Counter.

providerCaveats.statsbomb: StatsBomb Open Data events; coordinates converted from 120x80 to metres on 105x68.

name: Regain to shot time
descriptionQuick: How quickly the team turned a regain into a shot.
descriptionExplore: Median time from the start of a shot-ending open-play possession to its first shot.
descriptionAdvanced: Median over team chains (Regular Play / From Counter) containing a shot of (first shot clock - chain start clock).

providerCaveats.statsbomb: StatsBomb Open Data events; coordinates converted from 120x80 to metres on 105x68.

name: Shots
descriptionQuick: Total shots.
descriptionExplore: All shots excluding penalty shoot-outs.
descriptionAdvanced: count(type=shot, period != 5)

providerCaveats.statsbomb: StatsBomb Open Data events; coordinates converted from 120x80 to metres on 105x68.

name: Shots on target
descriptionQuick: Shots that would have gone in without the keeper.
descriptionExplore: Shots with outcome Goal, Saved or Saved To Post.
descriptionAdvanced: outcome in (Goal, Saved, Saved To Post)

providerCaveats.statsbomb: StatsBomb Open Data events; coordinates converted from 120x80 to metres on 105x68.

name: Goals
descriptionQuick: Goals scored (excluding shoot-outs).
descriptionExplore: Shot goals plus own goals in the team's favour.
descriptionAdvanced: count(shot outcome Goal) + count(Own Goal For), period != 5

providerCaveats.statsbomb: StatsBomb Open Data events; coordinates converted from 120x80 to metres on 105x68.

name: Expected goals (xG)
descriptionQuick: The quality of chances: how many goals an average team would score from these shots.
descriptionExplore: Sum of the provider's expected-goals values for every shot.
descriptionAdvanced: Sum of shot.statsbomb_xg (StatsBomb model) excluding the shoot-out.

providerCaveats.statsbomb: Uses StatsBomb's own xG model; other providers' xG differs.

name: Non-penalty xG
descriptionQuick: Chance quality without penalties.
descriptionExplore: xG excluding penalty kicks.
descriptionAdvanced: sum(statsbomb_xg) where shot.type != Penalty, period != 5

providerCaveats.statsbomb: StatsBomb Open Data events; coordinates converted from 120x80 to metres on 105x68.

name: xG per shot
descriptionQuick: How good the average chance was.
descriptionExplore: Mean xG of non-penalty shots.
descriptionAdvanced: npxg / non-penalty shots

providerCaveats.statsbomb: StatsBomb Open Data events; coordinates converted from 120x80 to metres on 105x68.

name: Goals minus xG
descriptionQuick: Whether the team scored more or fewer than its chances suggested.
descriptionExplore: Goals (excluding own goals) minus xG. Single-match values are noisy.
descriptionAdvanced: shot goals - xG, period != 5

providerCaveats.statsbomb: StatsBomb Open Data events; coordinates converted from 120x80 to metres on 105x68.

name: Set-piece xG share
descriptionQuick: How much of the team's threat came from set pieces.
descriptionExplore: Share of non-penalty xG from possessions starting from corners, free kicks or throw-ins.
descriptionAdvanced: npxG in chains with play_pattern in (From Corner, From Free Kick, From Throw In) / npxG

providerCaveats.statsbomb: StatsBomb Open Data events; coordinates converted from 120x80 to metres on 105x68.

name: Shot map
descriptionQuick: Where shots were taken and how good each chance was.
descriptionExplore: Every shot with location, xG, outcome, body part and player.
descriptionAdvanced: List of shots with canonical coordinates and provider xG.

providerCaveats.statsbomb: StatsBomb Open Data events; coordinates converted from 120x80 to metres on 105x68.

name: Penalty shoot-out
descriptionQuick: The penalty shoot-out, kick by kick.
descriptionExplore: Shoot-out kicks in order with outcome.
descriptionAdvanced: Shots in period 5.

providerCaveats.statsbomb: StatsBomb Open Data events; coordinates converted from 120x80 to metres on 105x68.

name: Starting formation
descriptionQuick: The formation the team started in.
descriptionExplore: Formation recorded in the Starting XI event.
descriptionAdvanced: starting_xi.tactics.formation, e.g. 433 -> 4-3-3

providerCaveats.statsbomb: StatsBomb Open Data events; coordinates converted from 120x80 to metres on 105x68.

name: Formation changes
descriptionQuick: When and how the team changed shape.
descriptionExplore: Starting formation, tactical shifts and substitutions in order.
descriptionAdvanced: Starting XI + Tactical Shift + Substitution events.

providerCaveats.statsbomb: StatsBomb Open Data events; coordinates converted from 120x80 to metres on 105x68.

name: Average positions
descriptionQuick: Where each player usually was when involved in passing.
descriptionExplore: Mean location of each player's passes and receptions.
descriptionAdvanced: As passing.network nodes, per scope.

providerCaveats.statsbomb: Event-based; reflects on-ball positions only, not full positioning (needs tracking).

name: Minutes played
descriptionQuick: Minutes on the pitch.
descriptionExplore: From lineup positions and substitutions.
descriptionAdvanced: Sum of on-pitch intervals from lineup position spells.

providerCaveats.statsbomb: StatsBomb Open Data events; coordinates converted from 120x80 to metres on 105x68.

name: Role profile
descriptionQuick: The role a player most resembled in this match.
descriptionExplore: Nearest of 14 tactical role archetypes from the player's per-90 actions, restricted to their position group.
descriptionAdvanced: Per-90 feature vector z-scored against a reference table, cosine similarity to hand-authored archetype centroids within the lineup position group; reports best and second-best role with similarity.

providerCaveats.statsbomb: Reference statistics are provisional until computed from a larger ingested corpus.

name: Team width
descriptionQuick: How wide the team stretched the pitch.
descriptionExplore: Distance between the widest outfield players, through the match.
descriptionAdvanced: Needs continuous tracking (Milestone 4).

providerCaveats.statsbomb: Not available from event data.

name: Compactness
descriptionQuick: How tightly grouped the team was.
descriptionExplore: Area of the convex hull of outfield players.
descriptionAdvanced: Needs continuous tracking (Milestone 4).

providerCaveats.statsbomb: Not available from event data.

name: Defensive line height
descriptionQuick: How high the back line stood.
descriptionExplore: Mean x of the deepest outfield line out of possession.
descriptionAdvanced: Needs continuous tracking (Milestone 4).

providerCaveats.statsbomb: Not available from event data; see pressing.defensive_action_height_m for an event-based proxy.

name: Key passes
descriptionQuick: Passes that set up a shot.
descriptionExplore: Passes flagged by the provider as the last pass before a shot (shot assists and goal assists).
descriptionAdvanced: count(pass where shot_assist or goal_assist), excluding the shoot-out. valueJson.assists = goal assists.

providerCaveats.statsbomb: Provider-flagged shot assists.

name: Expected assists (xA)
descriptionQuick: The quality of chances a player created for others.
descriptionExplore: Sum of the xG of shots that came directly from the player's passes.
descriptionAdvanced: sum(statsbomb_xg of the shot referenced by pass.assisted_shot_id) over key passes.

providerCaveats.statsbomb: Uses StatsBomb xG for the assisted shot.
